description: GET /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments — paginated list of the merchant's yield deployments (floYsh YaaS), newest first. sunset=false (default) lists the active deployments; sunset=true lists the archive. The two views are disjoint. Each item carries status, chainId, branding, internalHostname and sunsetAt. Read-only. Accepts a fresh JWT or a cached sk_* key.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

sunset.description: true = the archive (sunset deployments) instead of the active list.

name: yield_deployments_list
title: List yield deployments
